svg.title: One UDP session opened by SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE

g.text: Association: the control TCP connection bounds the whole UDP session
The session also ends after udp_session_idle_timeout (5m) of silence. Inside freedom each NAT socket closes after nat.idle_timeout (5m); a cached route is
forgotten after 1 minute unused. A packet that cannot be routed or sent is dropped and logged at Debug; the session continues. With block, CreateDatagram returns ErrBlocked.
18. from the socket the mapping policy picks
19. reply; the filtering policy may drop it
22. reply with SOCKS5 header, from destination
24. session ends: closes every outbound datagram
